picks.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro beats GPT-5.5 Pro on precision
picks.why_it_matters: A Chinese AI lab outperforming OpenAI on key benchmarks signals the foundation model layer is commoditizing faster than expected, creating openings for startups building differentiated applications rather than competing on base models.

picks.title: The business of AI is facing 4 harsh realities
picks.why_it_matters: Investor recalibration on AI economics—including compute costs and monetization challenges—may cool late-stage valuations and create better entry points for early-stage deals with capital-efficient approaches.

picks.title: New drug 'functionally cures' many hepatitis B virus infections
picks.why_it_matters: A breakthrough in treating a disease affecting 250M+ people globally validates continued opportunity in biotech platforms tackling chronic viral infections with novel mechanisms.
